message.content: {"rules":["For safety, self and origin must either have the same data-pointer address, or both be derived from a pointer to the same allocated object with the entire memory range between their data pointers in bounds of that object. For non-Sized pointees, metadata is ignored. This requirement applies both at compile time and at runtime.","For safety, the distance between the data pointers of self and origin, in bytes, must be an exact multiple of size_of::<u8>() (1 byte), because byte_offset_from delegates to offset_from on u8 pointers; this divisibility requirement is always satisfied."]}
